description: This PHP source file defines the StudioTree class, which extends MBPackageTree. It is part of the ModuleBuilder system in SuiteCRM, responsible for creating a tree structure representing modules and packages within the Studio interface. The class initializes a tree object, sets its ID, creates a StudioBrowser instance, and populates the tree with nodes retrieved from the browser. It also provides a getName() method returning a translated label for the modules section.

classes.name: StudioTree
classes.description: A class that extends MBPackageTree, representing a tree structure of modules and packages within SuiteCRM's Studio interface. It initializes the tree with nodes fetched from StudioBrowser and provides a method to get the section name.
